    • displayPingErrorDialogIfUiPresent

      public static void displayPingErrorDialogIfUiPresent(Client client)
      Display an error dialog informing the user that the provided connection was interrupted because some pings failed. This function can be called from any thread. The dialog will only be created if usingGUI() is true.
      Parameters:
      client - the client whose connection was closed because of a failing ping
